title: Götterdämmerung: Prelude to Act III
notable_excerpt: Opening (00:00); play the score MIDI in the browser to audition.
video_use_ideas: Use the opening Rhine texture for a moving transition before a dramatic turn.
legal_notes: Wagner composition public domain (d.1883; opera published in the nineteenth century). Modern CC0 encoding credited to LeftRight, after the historic piano/vocal score. Source file heading mentions Scene 1; catalogue entry is the Act III prelude piano score. Downloaded from Artform, whose Wagner score page explicitly labels each listed score public domain. Matched PDMX per-file metadata records CC0 with license_conflict=False; no conflicting rights text in the MXL. Original MuseScore page currently returns HTTP 403; no files downloaded from MuseScore.com. PDMX dataset-level CC BY 4.0 notice is distinct from the source score’s per-file CC0 dedication; credit for consulted metadata: Long, Novack, Berg-Kirkpatrick and McAuley, PDMX, https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.15571083. Only Artform’s independently labelled PD score is redistributed here. No pre-rendered preview: the site plays the score MIDI with an in-browser General MIDI synth; no third-party recording.
licence_meaning: PD / CC0 / PDM / US-gov recording and score. Commercial use, no credit needed (courtesy credit still listed where the source asks).
